slides.title: A Beginning, Ended
slides.text: This is the example ending for the template campaign — it plays when you finish the 'First Steps' quest. Open campaigns/_template/endings/endings.json to see how slides are authored, and quests/first_steps.json to see how a quest rolls the credits (ends_game).

slides.title: Well Met
slides.text: You helped where you could, and the square remembered it. (This slide only shows when karma is positive — try the Speech option with Mara, which nudges karma up.)

slides.title: Now Build Your Own
slides.text: Replace this town, this NPC, this quest, and these slides with your story. The frame does the rest.
